summative_rubric.title: What's Missing — Summative Rubric

rows.expectation_text: identify when symbols are being used as variables, and describe how they are being used

levels.descriptor: Recognises variable with prompts; treats it as the answer.
Identifies variables and explains they stand for unknowns.
Uses multiple variable symbols; explains they all behave identically.

rows.expectation_text: determine what needs to be added to or subtracted from addition and subtraction expressions to make them equivalent

levels.descriptor: Finds missing addends in simple equations with prompts.
Solves addition and subtraction missing-number equations to 100.
Distinguishes missing-minuend from missing-subtrahend; checks every answer.

rows.expectation_text: identify and use equivalent relationships for whole numbers up to 100, in various contexts

levels.descriptor: Generates 5+ equivalent expressions for whole numbers to 100.
Uses both addition and subtraction; includes 3-term expressions.

summative_rubric.usage_notes: Apply this rubric to combined evidence from Lesson 5 capstone.
summative_rubric.layout_description: One letter page, landscape. 5-column grid with 3 rows.

summative_task_script.title: Lesson 5 Summative Task — My Mystery Case
summative_task_script.purpose: End-of-unit summative integrating C2.1 + C2.2 + C2.3.
administration_steps: Walk through the Mystery Case Capstone Template.
Circulate; prompt children stuck on no-variable cases.
Score: case + equation + solve = L3; plus equivalent expression and reflection = L4.
summative_task_script.scoring_guidance: Coherent case (out of 2) + equation with variable (out of 3) + correct solution and check (out of 3) + equivalent expression (out of 2) = 10.
